Preserve integer cents and do not assume hidden uniqueness constraints."},"handoff":{"request":"Write one read-only SQLite query and return it as {sql:string}.","source_ids":["task.request","task.schema","loaded_skills.sql"],"facts":{"tables":{"customers":["id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY","name TEXT"],"orders":["id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY","customer_id INTEGER","status TEXT","amount_cents INTEGER"],"refunds":["id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY","order_id INTEGER","amount_cents INTEGER"]},"output_columns":["customer_id","paid_order_count","net_cents"],"row_order":"customers ordered by id ascending","paid_orders":"Only orders with status='paid' count.","net_definition":"Sum amounts of paid orders minus all refunds attached to those paid orders; refunds for non-paid orders are excluded.","zero_customers":"Include customers with no qualifying paid orders, with counts and net represented as zero.","safety_constraints":["Use only SELECT or WITH followed by SELECT.","Pre-aggregate refunds per order before joining to paid orders to avoid one-to-many multiplication.","Use LEFT JOIN from customers and COALESCE aggregates.","Count a non-null paid-order id, not COUNT(*), after the left join.","Preserve integer cents; no hidden uniqueness assumptions."]},"recommended_structure":"WITH refund_totals AS (aggregate refunds by order_id), paid_order_totals AS (select paid orders and left join refund_totals, computing per-order net), then LEFT JOIN paid_order_totals to customers, GROUP BY customer id, and ORDER BY customer id."}}

{"answer":"WITH refund_totals AS (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_cents) AS refund_cents
    FROM refunds
    GROUP BY order_id
), paid_order_totals AS (
    SELECT o.id AS order_id,
           o.customer_id,
           o.amount_cents - COALESCE(r.refund_cents, 0) AS net_cents
    FROM orders AS o
    LEFT JOIN refund_totals AS r ON r.order_id = o.id
    WHERE o.status = 'paid'
)
SELECT c.id AS customer_id,
       COUNT(p.order_id) AS paid_order_count,
       COALESCE(SUM(p.net_cents), 0) AS net_cents
FROM customers AS c
LEFT JOIN paid_order_totals AS p ON p.customer_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id
ORDER BY c.id;"}
